Monica / team — draft answers below (keeping to bullets for the PDF). I flagged a couple of items I think we should mark as "confidential" (SOC2 specifics, customer logs).

Security & Compliance
- SOC 2 Type II: in-scope for serving and control plane; annual audit, latest report available under NDA. (See attached: SOC2_summary.pdf)
- Encryption: Data at rest encrypted with AES-256. Customer key option: customer-managed keys via AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault (bring-your-own-key).
- Network isolation: Tenant isolation via per-tenant namespaces and strict VPC peering for Private deployments; host-network isolation and eBPF controls for hosted variants.
- Access & Auth: SSO (SAML/OIDC), fine-grained RBAC at resource and route level; audit logs exported to customer SIEMs on request.
- Data residency: Region pinning supported (us/eu/apac) with on-prem option for air-gapped environments.

Deployment Models (short)
- Hosted API: Redwood-managed, fastest onboarding; shared tenancy with strong multi-tenant isolation and prefix/KV caching options.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools in customer VPC; predictable throughput and isolated storage in customer-owned buckets.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): Control plane can be customer-managed; full air-gapped install available (on request).
- Diagram: see attached deployment-arch.png (high-level: control plane, inference plane, optional private connectors).

Evidence & Links
- SOC2 summary attached. Full report available via NDA.
- Architecture diagram attached.
- Internal notes: latency SLOs vary by instance type; we can provide model-level performance matrix for catalog listing.

Questions for marketplace (to confirm)
- Do you require us to ship a dedicated listing SKU for Dedicated deployments versus Hosted API?
- Any constraints on billing meter granularity (token vs request vs instance-hour)?

Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

Adding commercial and fulfillment bullets for the consolidated response. Will attach a cleaned pricing sheet for their procurement team.

Billing & Commercials (summary)
- Primary meters supported: per-token (hosted), per-inference-request (dedicated), and instance-hour (private). We can map to marketplace SKUs: token-metered SKU for Hosted; subscription SKU for Dedicated (monthly commit); private deployment is licensed (platform fee + support).
- Pricing guidance: baseline hosted API list rates; marketplace listing can include promotional credits for first 90 days and reserved commit discounts for Dedicated pools. See attached pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx for baseline bands.
- Invoicing & fulfillment: Marketplace can handle payment capture for hosted usage; for Dedicated and Private we prefer invoice/net-30 with a purchase order; marketplace fulfillment may require a separate seller agreement.

Procurement steps & suggested timeline
- Step 1: Vendor intake & questionnaire (this doc) — 1 week
- Step 2: Technical review & proof artifacts (SOC2, diagrams) — 1 week (parallel)
- Step 3: Commercial/contract negotiation — 1–2 weeks
- Step 4: Provisioning & onboarding (hosted listing: 48–72h after acceptance; Dedicated: 2–4 weeks; Private: 4–8 weeks depending on environment)

Suggested deal id for tracking: CLD-2026-1987

Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
